P-MSP-06.summary: An AI security service that watches for threats around the clock and keeps devices, servers and websites up to standard.

sections.heading: How it works
items: Watches for threats around the clock
Checks devices, servers and websites against security standards
Fixes routine issues automatically, with safeguards
Escalates anything serious to a person
Sends plain-English reports

sections.heading: Who it's for
items: Homes, small businesses and websites

sections.heading: Where it's at
items: Due in 2027

P-MSP-01.summary: Managed protection for Windows computers: Microsoft Defender hardened and tuned as the main shield, backed by IT7Q's own monitoring and an AI-assisted triage step that checks alerts before a person does.

sections.heading: What clients get
items: Defender configured to a hardened standard, not left on defaults
On-demand malware scanning as a second opinion
An IT7Q tray icon and a simple protection dashboard on each computer
Alerts reach IT7Q's own messaging system (Nexus), so nothing waits in a shared inbox

sections.heading: Why it's different
items: Alerts are triaged in-house by IT7Q's own AI (Andromeda) first; an outside AI service is used only when genuinely needed, so client data stays with IT7Q
Priced for homes and small businesses: from $68 a year per device (incl. GST)

sections.heading: Where it's at
items: Built for Windows fleets first
Being piloted on IT7Q's own monitored devices

P-MSP-02.summary: A small app that signs a client's device up to IT7Q managed protection in one click, without opening any connection into the client's network.

sections.heading: Why it matters
items: No inbound access, no router changes, nothing exposed to the internet
Takes the fiddly enrolment steps away from the client

sections.heading: Where it's at
items: Working enrolment service built
Currently in pilot on a monitored fleet

P-MSP-03.summary: Round-the-clock security monitoring across a client's computers, run on IT7Q's own self-hosted monitoring platform rather than a resold cloud service.

sections.heading: What it covers
items: Security events collected from Windows, macOS and Linux computers
Automatic alerting into IT7Q's automation and messaging systems
Plain-English follow-up when something needs doing

sections.heading: Where it's at
items: Running today on IT7Q's own devices
Sign-up guides written per platform; Chromebooks have known limits that are explained up front

P-MSP-04.summary: One place for clients to raise a support ticket, see their devices and read help articles, built in-house so it joins up with the rest of IT7Q's tools.

sections.heading: Roadmap
items: Stage 1: tickets and devices in a clean app (in progress)
Stage 2: a searchable knowledge base and FAQ
Stage 3: built into the Athena Browser with single sign-on
Stage 4: an AI support layer: automatic first-level triage, escalation, device-aware answers, queue watching and service-level alerts

sections.heading: Built with
items: A cross-platform app with its own back end and database, all self-hosted

P-MSP-05.summary: Health monitoring for servers and devices, with alerts and dashboards that flag problems before staff notice them.

sections.heading: What it watches
items: Processor (CPU) load
Memory
Disk space
Uptime, with alerts when something goes down
Dashboards at a glance

sections.heading: Where it's at
items: In use in-house
Being turned into a product for clients
